notes.title: New 100% FREE game coming soon!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

My 12th game is coming to Steam on December 4th! Make sure to wishlist it so that you can enjoy destroying mossy surfaces pixel-by-pixel as soon as it gets released! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618370/Mossy_Pixels/

P.S. It's 100% free, with no microtransactions or other nonsense. The only way to toss a coin into this game is to purchase a "donation" DLC below 😉:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696990/Mossy_Pixels_Lucky_Find/

I hope you'll enjoy it as much as I enjoyed making it. Have a great day! 💖

Kind regards,
Ivan (Khud0)

notes.title: Kickstarting my next FREE Steam game!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

My 12th Steam release is going to be another relaxing [u]free[/u] game! If you'd like to take a part in this project and get your name inscribed in it, please consider supporting it over on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/khud0/mossy-pixel]Kickstarter[/url]. <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403952/b2cce5a001b2b660dc0eee6b58e17366108162b1.gif[/img]

And don't forget to wishlist Mossy Pixels on Steam, so that you can enjoy destroying mossy surfaces pixel-by-pixel as soon as it gets released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618370/Mossy_Pixels/

This game [u]will[/u] be released and [u]will[/u] be [u]100% free for everyone[/u], regardless of whether it reaches its funding goal or not. However, your support would greatly help me stay on track and keep making 1 free game per year in the future!

Speaking of which, don't forget to grab my previous free game, in case you missed it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067760/Trash_Bomber/

Thank you for playing my games and for considering helping me out. Have a wonderful day! :)

Kind regards,
Ivan (Khud0)

notes.title: 2 new games coming soon! (One of which is 100% FREE!)
notes.content:
Dear players,

In 2 weeks, I'm going to release my 11th game on Steam! 🥳

Meet Turret Rampage, a score-chasing tower defense, in which [b]YOU[/b] play as the [b]ONLY[/b] tower! Repel enemy waves by quickly moving between their tunnels and using the right weapons for every foe! 💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2520310/Turret_Rampage/

If you'd like to see how this game was made, there is an ongoing devlog series where I share the path this game took to become a finished product:

[previewyoutube=w58r0qGjVnA;full][/previewyoutube]
Also, after this (relatively) big project, I'm going to wind down and finish another small, but [b]100% FREE[/b] game. Make sure to wishlist it so that you can enjoy destroying mossy surfaces pixel-by-pixel as soon as it gets released! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618370/Mossy_Pixels

I hope you'll enjoy these games, and I'm looking forward to hearing what you think about them. 😉

Sincerely yours,
Ivan (Khud0)

notes.title: Meet Alive Paint: A Coloring Book That Animates Itself!
notes.content:
Dear Player,

If you're a creative person who's into zen and relaxation or you have a kid who likes to draw, check out my upcoming Steam game: a coloring book that animates itself! Paint its desaturated pages with vibrant colors to breathe life into its inhabitants, and they will show you a little performance in return!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1706480/Alive_Paint/

I'm sure it will help you unleash your creativity, unwind after a hard working day or just have some fun and forget about the problems for an hour or two. Hope you'll consider giving it a try! :)

Yours sincerely,
Ivan (Khud0)

notes.title: New release! (+ a FREE bonus game!)
notes.content:
Today is a big day for me, and I'd love to share the joy with you, too!

First of all, my new game, Maggie the Magnet, is out on Steam! Now you can get a few hours of fun with magnets and gravity for just under $3!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301840/Maggie_the_Magnet/
What's even better is that this game comes with a bonus: a separate, 100% free "hidden object" game with randomly generated puzzles. There are no ads, no in-game purchases, just you and the so-called "incinerator"! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067760/Trash_Bomber/
If you're curious to see how these games were made, I always share the process I go through in order to turn game ideas into finished projects over on my YouTube channel.

[previewyoutube=-UFLG2d35fo;full][/previewyoutube]
And just in case you'd like to learn more about my projects, help me stay afloat as an independent game developer, and get your name featured in my future games & videos, I cordially invite you to join me on [url=https://patreon.com/khud0]Patreon[/url]!

I hope you'll enjoy your time in my games! Have a wonderful day. :)

Sincerely yours,
Ivan (Khud0)
